description: J-REIT ETF (1343, 1321) and TSE REIT index daily data used for the ONR overnight strategy (docs/PREREG_onr_forward.md). IMPORTANT: this dataset exists in TWO shapes with the SAME basenames in different directories -- a permanent full-history OHLCV snapshot in backtest_data/, and a live/forward-tracking feed with fewer columns in data/onr/. Do not assume a schema from the filename alone; check the directory.
source: Yahoo Finance chart API (ETF 1343, 1343 dividends via events=div, ETF 1321), kabutan code=0105 (東証REIT指数, TSE REIT index) -- see backtest_data/reit_onr_20260904/manifest.md and scripts/paper_onr.py
retention: backtest_data/reit_onr_<date>/ is a permanent MD5-stamped snapshot (never overwritten in place; a refresh lands in a new dated directory). data/onr/*.csv is the live forward-tracking feed maintained by scripts/paper_onr.py: appended/self-healed (existing dates get refreshed values but are never dropped from history).

backtest_data/reit_onr_<date>/etf_1343_d.coverage: 2008-09-16..snapshot date, ~4409 rows (see manifest.md for the exact count/date at snapshot time)

open.notes: known-defective: source has a documented 0.0 open on some early rows (e.g. 2009-01-05) -- treat open==0.0 as a source erratum, not a real print

backtest_data/reit_onr_<date>/reit_index.coverage: partial, recent only (2025-06-16..snapshot date per manifest.md) -- kabutan does not serve the full index history for free; the PREREG's primary index-level judgment cell (2003-04~) was NOT obtainable, see manifest.md for the full list of attempted sources and why each failed

data/onr/etf_1343_daily.csv.description: LIVE forward-tracking feed for paper_onr.py -- NOT the same schema as backtest_data's etf_1343_daily.csv despite the identical filename

open.meaning: closing-auction-adjacent daily open (see scripts/paper_onr.py for exact print used)

div_yen.meaning: dividend amount if this date is an ex-dividend date

known_defects: only open/close/div_yen -- no high/low/volume, unlike the backtest_data snapshot of the same-named file

data/onr/reit_index_daily.csv.description: LIVE forward-tracking feed -- NOT the same schema as backtest_data's reit_index_daily.csv
known_defects: only open/close -- no high/low, unlike the backtest_data snapshot of the same-named file

SAME BASENAME, DIFFERENT SCHEMA: backtest_data/reit_onr_<date>/etf_1343_daily.csv and reit_index_daily.csv are full OHLC(V) history snapshots; data/onr/etf_1343_daily.csv and reit_index_daily.csv are the live forward-tracking feed with fewer columns (open/close[/div_yen] only). Reading the wrong one, or assuming they interchange, silently drops high/low/volume.

the TSE REIT INDEX (not the 1343 ETF) has NO free full-history source as of the 2026-09-04 snapshot -- kabutan's reit_index_daily.csv only goes back to 2025-06-16; the PREREG's primary judgment cell needing 2003-04~ index history was not obtainable (see manifest.md for the 6 sources attempted and why each failed: JPX chart-only, JPX bulk data is paid, Yahoo ^TREIT is a stale delisted quote, stooq blocked by a JS PoW challenge, investing.com bot-blocked, matsui client-side-only)
etf_1321_daily.csv has a documented open==0.0 erratum on at least its first row (2009-01-05) -- a zero open is a source artifact, not a real print

guard percentile thresholds used by paper_onr.py's status.json are a frozen one-time computation over the backtest_data/reit_onr_20260904/ snapshot (n=4399, after dropping open<=0/close<=0 rows and a |log r|>0.10 glitch filter) -- they are NOT recomputed as new data arrives in data/onr/
